verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents its own pre-filing assessment offerings: a case assessment intake, a strategy session with a pre-session case review and immigration roadmap, and pathway mapping. Its packages cover O-1A petitions. However, nothing describes a structured O-1A evaluation or how evidence is weighed against the USCIS extraordinary-ability criteria. Missing for 10: documented O-1A criteria-by-criteria evaluation methodology, a written qualification report or scoring deliverable, an explicit O-1A-specific assessment step before filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed
